title: B2B Signup
summary: Convert work email interest into a team workspace with clear plan selection and invite paths.

strategies.name: Work-email only gate
strategies.tradeoffs: Better lead quality; blocks freelancers on personal mail.
strategies.when: Enterprise sales-assisted motions and domain-based SSO later.

strategies.name: Self-serve trial then sales assist
strategies.tradeoffs: Faster PLG; sales loses early discovery context.
strategies.when: Products with clear free trial value under seat caps.

strategies.name: Invite-first team formation
strategies.tradeoffs: Network effects; solo admins feel blocked.
strategies.when: Collaboration tools where value needs ≥2 seats.

strategies.name: SSO-first for enterprise domains
strategies.when: Known enterprise domains or security-sensitive categories.

forgottenStates: Personal email soft-warn with continue option
Domain already claimed by another admin
Trial already used on same company domain
neverDo: Ask for credit card before any product value on a free trial
Require phone sales booking to start a trial
Dump users into an empty workspace with no next step
Use consumer social signup as the only path
Hide seat pricing until after team invites
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
